name: Tubbs 2017

ignition.source: CAL FIRE incident API record 'Tubbs Fire (Central LNU Complex)', Latitude and Longitude fields ('off of Hwy 128 and Bennett Ln, Calistoga'). An incident point, not a surveyed origin: it may be off by hundreds of metres.

hours_note: Protocol amendment A9: the first mapped outlines are at 35.25, 40.9 and 43.0 h after ignition.
box_note: the final perimeter's bounding box plus 10 km (data/tubbs_2017/box.json), clipped to the downloaded LANDFIRE tile. Other fires of the same night (Nuns, Atlas) burned inside this box and are not modelled.

landfire.units_source: data/tubbs_2017/landfire/VERSION.md: CC %, CH m x 10, CBH m x 10, CBD kg/m3 x 100

live_moisture_note: Scott and Burgan 2005 live scenario L1 (fully cured herbaceous 30 %, woody 60 %): an assumption for an October fire at the end of the dry season, not a measurement. Protocol amendment A5.

buildings.note: USGS CC0 release (doi 10.5066/P1QX6UXD): the pre-fire building points. Positions go to the model; bldg_cond is used only for scoring.

detections.note: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m standard detections (US government work). Clipped to the final Tubbs outline plus 500 m because the Nuns and Atlas fires burned in the same box that night. Protocol A11: reported, not part of the fitting score.
